$comment: Board for the Continental Rift vertical slice (#203) - NOT content: it lives outside content/maps/, so nothing ships it and content:validate never lists it. The cracking ice shelf below the Glacier of Origins: two ice pillars, open snow, a crack in the glacier wall at the bottom-left corner (the timed way out) and a reader trapped beside it. One frost spawn stands right above the party's first spawn, so a hero's first turn can be a swing (the slice's tests read the buffed roll off it).
